answer: In this PoA design, each service interaction contributes a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust edge, while reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life. Freshly spawned sybil identities therefore possess near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. Sustained honest service is required; a cluster cannot forge influence through mutual endorsements, and even a trellis of colluding nodes or a dune of aliases remains below threshold without trusted, durable peers.
